x, y, n = map(float, input().split())

closest_diff = 1e9
numerator = 0
denominator = 1

for b in range(1, int(n) + 1):
    a_upper = int(math.ceil(b * x / y))
    a_lower = int(math.floor(b * x / y))
    
    diff_upper = abs(x / y - a_upper / b)
    if diff_upper < closest_diff:
        closest_diff = diff_upper
        numerator = a_upper
        denominator = b

    diff_lower = abs(x / y - a_lower / b)
    if diff_lower < closest_diff:
        closest_diff = diff_lower
        numerator = a_lower
        denominator = b

print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
</translated_code>
